title: fea.trends
description: `fea.trends(Name, Value, ...)` returns a `fea.Trends` summary over a bounded recent-run window.
behaviors: `WindowSize` is the only option and defaults to 16.

Window size must be a positive exact structural scalar. All eight integer classes and ordinary integral doubles are accepted exactly; zero, negative, fractional, nonfinite, out-of-range, nonscalar, and resident values reject before artifact-store access.
Window size and returned run/count metadata remain exact typed integers. Timing, rate, ratio, and aggregate measurement fields remain binary64.
The query is host-side, performs no provider execution, and does not require native OCCT.

faqs.question: Is zero an unlimited window?
faqs.answer: No. `WindowSize` must be positive; omit it to use the default of 16.
